name: Kraftwerk
hook: The most important node in this entire map, because almost every electronic lineage runs back through it.
blurb: A German group who built their own studio and their own instruments and made music that sounded deliberately mechanical, at a time when rock musicians were trying to sound human and loose. They were searching for a German identity after the war that did not copy Britain or America. But what happened to their music is more interesting than what they meant by it. Black American audiences in Detroit and in New York, the Bronx included, heard it as music from the future and claimed it as their own. The Electrifying Mojo in Detroit and club DJs in New York played them next to funk records, and young people there built two entire genres, techno and electro, out of it, which almost certainly was not the plan.
